# BuildBase console setup

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/capture (pnpm capture --only console). Do not edit; re-run it. -->

The RenderWeld store (reelforge.buildbase.app) runs on BuildBase: accounts and sign-in, the licence items and their prices, checkout, licence keys, webhooks, docs and blog content. This page is that configuration, read from the **development environment** (`fsyqdskf`, the test site reelforge-dev.buildbase.app, Stripe test keys) on 2026-11-22, rather than screenshots of the console. Production has the same structure with live keys and its own URLs.

Secrets never appear: they are `${env:NAME}` placeholders in the blueprint or shown as "[redacted]". The page is regenerated with `pnpm capture --only console` (docs/CAPTURE.md). The screens to photograph by hand, with their menu paths, are listed in [the console screenshot checklist](../../CONSOLE_SCREENSHOTS.md).

### Item type

Console: **Billing** > **Item types**.

| Key | Name | Live version | What it allows |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| reelforge-licence | RenderWeld licence | 2 | Fixed or Free, License keys, Files, Up to 4 variants |

### Item "RenderWeld Personal" (published)

Free licence key for personal, hobby, study and evaluation use (noncommercial). Needs a BuildBase account.

| Variant | Price | Benefits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Noncommercial | Free | Personal licence key (1 server, noncommercial) (1 activation); Getting started |

### Item "RenderWeld Commercial" (published)

Commercial licence for anything that earns money: monetised channels, client work, companies. One-time. TEST PRICES (dev).

| Variant | Price | Benefits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Solo | 49.00 USD | Licence key (1 server) (1 activation); Getting started |
| Studio | 149.00 USD | Licence key (3 servers) (3 activations); Getting started |
| Agency | 399.00 USD | Licence key (10 servers) (10 activations); Getting started |

Archived items (kept for past orders): "RenderWeld".

## Webhooks

Console: **Settings** > **Webhooks**. BuildBase signs each delivery; the store checks the signature with the endpoint's secret (stored as a Worker secret, never here).

| Name | URL | Events | Enabled | Signing secret |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RenderWeld store (development) | https://reelforge-dev.buildbase.app/api/webhooks/buildbase | * | yes | [redacted] |

## Content

Console: **Content** > **Docs**, **Content** > **Blogs** and **Content** > **Collections** (under **Data**).

### Docs

21 doc pages (drafts included) in 9 folders: Quick start (`start`), Install (`install`), REST API (`api`), MCP (`mcp`), Providers (`providers`), Manifest (`manifest`), Cookbook (`cookbook`), Privacy (`privacy`), Troubleshooting (`troubleshooting`). The repository publishes them (docs/DOCS_PUBLISHING.md).

### Blog

2 published posts.

## Email

Console: **Messaging** > **Sender accounts** (and **Messaging** > **Templates**).

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| A usable default sender | yes |
| Email templates | 64 notification, 18 auth, 1 default |
| Waitlist emails (registered, approved, rejected) | off, off, off |

In the development environment sign-up runs in test mode: no mail is sent and the verification code is always 424242, which is how the walkthrough videos sign up.
